media.quote: El objetivo es realizar una terapia génica; esto es, cambiar la letra del gen mutado, para corregir el defecto genético de origen antes de que el daño neurológico sea irreversible
media.quoteEn: The goal is to carry out a gene therapy; that is, to change the letter of the mutated gene, to correct the underlying genetic defect before the neurological damage becomes irreversible

media.quote: El objetivo es realizar una terapia génica; esto es, cambiar la letra del gen mutado, aunque sería individualizada para Claudia también podría ser el medio para solucionar otros casos en el mundo
media.quoteEn: The goal is to carry out a gene therapy; that is, to change the letter of the mutated gene — although it would be tailored to Claudia, it could also be the means to solve other cases around the world

media.quoteEn: A team of researchers is ready to develop a personalised gene therapy that could change the course of the disease, but time is running against them and the project needs three million euros to become a reality
